structured.approach: Attempt 3 fixes the G1 refusal on the connector check. I removed the blanket sentence "No source-system connector is affected". The connector row in feat.prebacklog now matches what org.connector_inventory says: no connector is affected by the ap_aging library, and the inventory says nothing about ap_pipeline, ap_forecast or ap_portal. That gap is now open question OQ-3, which asks whether the CR-1 vendor-feed change or the other repositories affect a connector. While re-checking for similar overreach, I also changed "The ticket asks for no change of provider or model" to "The ticket does not mention any change of provider or model". Both files are rewritten in full; feat.intake has no content change. Everything else carries over from attempt 2. The ticket is split into CR-0 to CR-7 and linked to R-AP-12. The entry is checked against D-2026-031, D-2026-044, D-2026-050, L-007 and L-011, the regulatory sources and the model dependency map. ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455 were read in this session and are listed as related, not duplicates. The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not available, so their absence is disclosed as OQ-1. Shell use is denied in this step, so I used only Read, Glob, Grep and Write.

claims.text: The intake is Zendesk ticket ZD-48600 (sample, synthetic) from the Customer Feedback channel, received 2026-10-24, with source link hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ZD-48600.md.
The ticket asks for changes in ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal, and an end-to-end proof: feed -> delays -> risk -> overdue list -> portal table.
The entry is linked to roadmap item R-AP-12 (give AP managers earlier visibility of overdue payables, Q4 2026, AP module, owner PM). It is not linked to R-AP-14 (aging export for finance close).
No regulatory source applies to this change.
No source-system connector is affected by the ap_aging library. The inventory does not cover ap_pipeline, ap_forecast or ap_portal, so whether those are affected is left open.
ap_forecast uses provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2 (config src/ap_forecast/models.json), for the payment-delay explanation. vendor_risk uses no LLM; it is a rule on the predicted delay.
No conflict with prior decisions: overdue_with_risk covers unpaid invoices only (D-2026-050), amounts stay Decimal (D-2026-044), and days past due are assumed to be calendar days (D-2026-031).
Lesson L-007 requires explicit boundary tests: exactly 30 days past due, and predicted delays of exactly 30 and 10.
ZD-48211 (received 2026-10-20, open, ap_aging) asks to flag open invoices more than 30 days past their due date as overdue, and says paid invoices never count as overdue.
ZD-48501 (received 2026-10-24, open, ap_aging and ap_portal) adds overdue_summary(invoices, as_of) for unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due, plus a badge-overdue portal badge.
ZD-48455 (received 2026-10-22, open, ap_portal) highlights the 61-90 and 'Over 90 days' aging rows with CSS class row-overdue and adds a total row.
According to the source file, the change is tier T2 with no finance posting, authentication, tenancy or payment execution, and the risk label is advisory only.

open_questions: OQ-1: The Pre Backlog sheet and the DevOps board were not in context, so the duplicate check covered only the requirement files. PM: please confirm there is no existing entry.
OQ-2: Is delay_days in calendar days, and should early payments (zero or negative delay) be included? D-2026-031 covers aging buckets only.

OQ-3: The connector inventory covers only ap_aging. Is any source-system connector affected by the ap_pipeline vendor-feed change (paid_date) or by the ap_forecast or ap_portal changes, and should the feed change be recorded in the inventory?
OQ-4: How should a row be handled when paid and paid_date disagree?
OQ-5: What should vendor_risk return for a vendor with an empty history?
OQ-6: Should renderOverdueRisk HTML-escape vendor names and ids?
OQ-7: Should this entry be grouped with, or sequenced after, the related open items ZD-48211 and ZD-48501, which share the same overdue rule?
structured.summary: Both REQ-01 outputs are rewritten in full and the G1 refusal is fixed. The connector check now says only what org.connector_inventory supports: no connector is affected by the ap_aging library. Connector impact for ap_pipeline, ap_forecast and ap_portal is not covered by the inventory and is raised as OQ-3. One inferred phrase about the model was also tightened. The entry is still linked to R-AP-12, has no decision-log conflict and lists ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455 as related open items. The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were still not available, so the duplicate check covers only the repository's requirement files (OQ-1). There are four assumptions and seven non-blocking open questions; none blocks the step. This step sent no notification; the entry is the content for the PM gate.
